prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: free cash flow is 23.5% of the market value, a solid cash return. Also in its favour: return on capital employed is 20.5%, a strong return on the money in the business; profit grew 62.6% a year on average over three years; and profit grew 174% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: growth, the balance sheet, what the price asks for the earnings.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores only 17 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also against it: the share price is 15.2% lower than a year ago; over the past year the share did 12.9 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; and the 3-year maximum drawdown was -41.0%, a deep fall. Other areas on this side: price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 10 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 54 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet. That gives an educational rating of Overweight with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
